anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De Oratione exists (only copyrighted Greer/O'Meara/Oulton-Chadwick); nothing to compare against. Sense checked against the Greek and cited Scripture wording.

apparatus: XVI.1 verb cluster garbled in transmission; rendered by required four-verb mapping, flagged rough.
XVI.2: T margin damaged ~5 lines after distribution formula; gap marked, unfilled.
XVI.3: T marginal 'the writing has failed' (ἔσφαλται γραφή) at Esther/Haman passage plus ~1-line lacuna; rendered as fragments.
πεφίμωντο (muzzled lions) vs ἐπεφίμωντο variant recorded.

choices.why: idiōtikēn = of an unskilled layman; the error is unexamined piety, held 'with great integrity' — Origen is gentle here.
parakolouthēmata are necessary consequents (shadow follows body); 'concomitants' keeps the philosophical register of the body/shadow analogy.

choices.english: according to the analogy of faith
choices.why: Direct Rom 12:6 echo; Origen applies the Spirit's distribution formulae (1 Cor 12:7, 11) to prayer-gifts.
phimoō = muzzle/gag; the invisible lions are gagged before Daniel — stronger than mere silence.

pass_a_gloss: One prayer to God through Christ, mapped across four verbs (pray/entreat/petition/thank) to God/Father/Lord; the Lord is Lord of the nobly nurtured, led from fear to love, whose slave/son characters the heart-seer reads. Earthly asks disobey the command for heavenly great things; bodily grants are mere shadow-consequents of principal spiritual gifts, distributed 'for profit / by analogy of faith / as he wills.' Hannah's soul out-bore her body; strong passages on Hezekiah, Daniel, furnace-dew, and Jonah survive amid T corruption at the Esther/Haman lines.
